title: Normalized restricted integral identity agrees with the completed tensor unit
statement: Under the same scalar-object, realization-comparison, and identity normalization hypotheses as the integral scalar-unit normalization, the underlying normalized identity arrow equals the CompletedLineTensor.unit component on the corresponding completed object.

source.place: Tags 03DA, 06YY and 07A6, specialized to the identity coefficient map; the completed tensor-unit comparison is the intermediate step before intrinsic restriction.

proof.text: Rewrite the normalized identity equation using hS and hχ, compare the transported tensor identity with the ordinary completed tensor unit by the K-flat multiplication calculation, and transport along the completed comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_integral_scalar_unit_underlying_bridge
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l) (T : Scheme.{max u v})
    (S : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω (s := .integral E) (t := .integral E)
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier E.carrier
        (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier)) T)
    (hS : S.functor ⋙ RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) =
      RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) ⋙
        integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E.carrier E.carrier
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T)
    (hχ : ∀ K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E),
      HEq (S.realization.inv.app K)
        ((completedScalarComparison l E.carrier E.carrier
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T).app K.obj))
    (h : ∀ W : Scheme.{max u v},
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier E.carrier
        (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier)).map W = 𝟙 _)
    (e : ScalarIdentity.{u, v} l Ω h T S)
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E)) :
    HEq ((e.iso.hom.app K).hom)
      ((CompletedLineTensor.unit l E.carrier T K.obj
        (CompletedLineTensor.intrinsic_complete l E.carrier T
          ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l E.carrier T).obj K))).hom)
